MUST be an exactly regular 4-column by 2-row sheet, EIGHT equal cells. The first four complete legion bodies currently extend past cell edges and into the lower half. Shrink and reposition each of the four legion bodies into its own top-row cell, with at least 12% empty transparent margin on all four sides of EVERY cell. Sword Legion must have ALL blades and boots contained; Arrow ALL wings; Arm BOTH gauntlets and boots; Beast ALL claws and tail. No object crosses x=25%,50%,75% or y=50% boundaries. Scale each object down until there is generous empty alpha gutter around every side, maximum object height 75% of its cell height. Bottom row same original police baton, pistol, chain strip and cuff, also centered strictly within their cells, 12% margins. Keep four top-row legions fully visible, preserve every detail and native RIGHT facing direction. No additions, letters, effect backgrounds, grid lines or captions. Change layout containment only.
